name: merges touching intervals and becomes true only on full coverage
input: odd center ticks from one through ninety-nine
test:
tracker = AxisCoverageTracker()
for center in range(1, 100, 2):
    covered = tracker.ingest(center)
    assert covered is (center == 99)
assert tracker.ingest(50) is True

name: treats repeated and separated events correctly
input: overlapping duplicates and two intervals with a continuous gap
test:
tracker = AxisCoverageTracker()
assert tracker.ingest(1) is False
assert tracker.ingest(1) is False
assert tracker.ingest(5) is False
assert tracker.ingest(3) is False

name: clips boundary events and ignores intervals outside the axis
input: centers whose intervals lie at or beyond the two boundaries
test:
tracker = AxisCoverageTracker()
assert tracker.ingest(-5) is False
assert tracker.ingest(-1) is False
assert tracker.ingest(101) is False
assert tracker.ingest(105) is False
